thread:
Alice M: Heads-up: I'm landing a change that annotates metering events with 'route_label' and a 'weight' float for sampled requests. Canaries tomorrow AM. Ping if this touches anything downstream.
Ben (eng-platform): quick check  does the new field change schema id? invoice-preview reads by schema name/version. If it's additive we're fine.
Farid (ingest): additive only, we'll keep same schema version but add optional fields. We'll also emit a 'weight_normalized' boolean when we coerce legacy clients.
Carla (billing): important: preview aggregation assumes integer token_count. If weight != 1 we need to apply it to token_count before aggregation. Also rounding rules: do we round per-event or at tenant-aggregate?
Alice M: plan is to multiply token_count by weight and keep high-precision through tally; final invoices rounded per-line item. Avoid per-event rounding to reduce bias.
Deniz (console-ux): dashboard note: charts and sparklines expect ints. We need to update axis formatting and tooltip text. Also want an explanatory microcopy for preview: "counts may include sampler weights".
Carla (billing): also add a debug column in invoice-preview CSV for raw_weight so support can trace.
Ben (eng-platform): thought: some clients set weight<1 for sampling; others send >1 for amplification. We should cap weight at sane bounds in ingest (0.0001..100) and alert if outside.
OpsBot: alert rule created: metering.weight_out_of_bounds > 0 for 5m -> notify #eng-platform-oncall.
Farid (ingest): implemented cap in ingest proxy + flag to disable. We'll log when capping occurs.
Ben (eng-platform): another concern: dedupe. With retries we might double-count if retries change route_label. We should add a stable route_resolution_token on first hop and propagate.
Alice M: agree. We'll generate route_resolution_token at proxy and attach to event_id set. That token is required for dedupe in tally step.
Carla (billing): replay check request: before we flip wider, replay 48h of events with new weighting applied and compare invoice-preview deltas. If >0.2% tenants have >$0.50 difference, we pause.
Deniz (console-ux): UI rollout idea: show a soft-warning ribbon in invoice-preview for the first two billing windows after rollout explaining differences and linking to docs.
Ben (eng-platform): I'll wire a feature flag so we can enable the ribbon gradually.
Farid (ingest): note: we saw a small spike in enrichment latency when route_label missing triggered a remote lookup. To avoid that, proxy will backfill route_label from routing cache.
Alice M: good. Make sure that backfill doesn't change semantics of route tags used for discounts.
Carla (billing): on discounts: enrichment map uses route_label -> discount set. If route_label normalization changes, we need to run a discount-replay comparing old vs new labels.
Ben (eng-platform): will run a discount-replay on a snapshot and post numbers. Expect ~0.01% mismatch from legacy aliases.
meter-bot: job: discount-replay-20240622 queued (job id dr-20240622-09).
Ben (eng-platform): PRs: https://git.redwood/repo/pull/12899 (proxy: route token + backfill), https://git.redwood/repo/pull/12901 (ingest: weight cap + normalization), https://git.redwood/repo/pull/12902 (tally: float accumulation).
Farid (ingest): also added a small histogram metric meter_weight_bucketed{route=\"...\"} so we can see weight distribution per-route.
Deniz (console-ux): will update tooltips and create admin toggle to surface raw weight in debug view for tenant support.
Carla (billing): replay results are in: out of 12000 tenants, 4 tenants had discount mapping differences; granularity <0.04%. Dollar deltas all < $0.20. Ben: can you map the offending aliases?
Ben (eng-platform): mapped aliases + re-run; differences now zero. Ready for 30% canary tomorrow.
Alice M: schedule: 30% canary Saturday 06:00 UTC with 24h soak. Billing team will run full invoice-preview reconciliation at 12h intervals.
OpsBot: deploy-canary: eng-proxy v4.21 -> 30% started at 2024-06-23T06:00:00Z.
Farid (ingest): CI: added an e2e that simulates mixed weights and asserts that tenant-level totals equal sum(event.token_count * weight) within 1e-6.
Carla (billing): one open item: ledger storage column was INT historically. We must convert to NUMERIC or fixed-point. Migration planned on Monday; will need a short maintenance window.
Alice M: noted. We'll coordinate migration timeline and keep previews using temporary in-memory float accumulation until db migration completes.
Deniz (console-ux): drafted ribbon text: "We're rolling out weighted sampling in metering. Invoice previews may change slightly during rollout. Learn more". Will link to /docs/metering-weight.
Ben (eng-platform): posting canary dashboard link: https://dash.redwood/canary/weights-2024-06-23
Carla (billing): all good from billing side pending DB migration.
Alice M: thanks everyone. If we see unexpected >0.5% tenant deltas, trigger rollback. Keep thread updated.
meter-bot: canary-status: 30% -> soak in progress.
